scope: Exact original native AccountInfo key-uniqueness guard vs P6 byte-key projection on exactly12 actual accounts. One-byte arbitrary payload is ignored by both guards, no data borrows occur; not a whole caller proof or arbitrary runtime heap theorem.
instruction_prefix_lengths: 0..9; excludes arbitrary long wrong-length slices (native source literal inequality rejects them but no universal Kani claim)
exact_error_enum:
